name: The Archive
description: Rain against the glass. A recorder. Two cups, one still warm. Somewhere outside this room, an absent woman is being welcomed home.
alt: Worn room with lamp, recorder, kettle and rain-streaked window.
quote: Porchlight wants to welcome her back. Before we do, can you tell me what this account actually proves?
speaker: Rafi Kline

name: Porchlight
description: The lights are warm. The welcome is ready. The uncertainty has been cropped out of the picture.
alt: Rooftop cafe with lanterns, plants and a welcome display.
quote: I am returning carefully. The answer is consent that can be revised.
speaker: The returned account · recording

name: The Oracle
description: Fragments arrange themselves into a reassuring circle. There is no space left for a question.
alt: Observatory with translucent panes in an incomplete ring.
quote: The account is authentic. A coherent account can be comforting.
speaker: Oracle

name: The Arbiter
description: Columns, seals and a closed palm. Every answer begins by defining the question it is allowed to answer.
alt: Records hall with a Warden silhouette at an amber threshold.
quote: Authenticity and authority are different columns. Tell me which one you need.
speaker: Arbiter
